relationships.subject: IL-4/IL-13
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-4/IL-13 promoted the phosphorylation of JAK1, JAK2, STAT3, and STAT6 in HaCaT cells, which was significantly suppressed in both the dexamethasone and PKN treatment groups

relationships.subject: Pulsatilla koreana Nakai extract
relationships.evidence_quote: PKN extract inhibited JAK/STAT phosphorylation stimulated by IL-4/IL-13.

relationships.subject: Pulsatilla koreana Nakai extract
relationships.evidence_quote: High concentrations of PKN extract significantly increased the expression of filaggrin, involucrin, and loricrin proteins

key_findings: PKN extract alleviates mite-induced atopic dermatitis-like symptoms in NC/Nga mice and restores skin barrier proteins.
PKN suppresses IL-4/IL-13-induced JAK1/JAK2/STAT3/STAT6 phosphorylation in keratinocytes.
